mapper.select: SELECT r.CHAT_ROOM_NO, r.CHAT_ROOM_NM FROM CHAT_ROOM r INNER JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER m ON (r.CHAT_ROOM_NO = m.CHAT_ROOM_NO) WHERE m.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND m.LEFT_DTTM IS NULL
SELECT * FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE CHAT_ROOM_NO = #{chatRoomNo} ORDER BY REG_DTTM ASC
